description: This is a Python source file containing an integration test for the AWS IoT SDK, specifically testing offline publish message queueing with configurable drop behaviors, involving threading, network error simulation, and message verification.

classes.name: threadPub
classes.description: Implements a publishing thread that simulates network errors and message publishing during offline scenarios.

classes.name: threadSub
classes.description: Implements a subscribing thread that receives messages from a topic to verify message queueing behavior.

methods.name: generateAnswer
methods.description: Generates expected message queueing results based on the configured drop behavior and queue size.

methods.name: performConfigurableOfflinePublishQueueTest
methods.description: Performs the integration test by configuring offline queues, running publisher and subscriber threads, and verifying message integrity under different drop policies.
